failure_pattern_summary: Most failures are early 409 SUBCONTRACT_STOCK_OUTBOX_CONFLICT responses caused by legacy inspect payloads that lack required SubcontractWriteCarrierBase fields now required by InspectRequest. One service-layer test directly constructs InspectRequest and fails validation for the same missing carrier fields. The original 200/404/409 business branches are blocked before they can execute.
classification_rationale: Evidence points to target test fixture/payload/direct InspectRequest construction drift against current schema carrier requirements. The fix can be confined to the target test by adding valid carrier fields and preserving original 200/404/409 branch assertions.
